ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 80 of 2002 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (as amended by Law No. 36/2014 and Law No. 154/2019) with Executive Regulations under Prime Minister Decree No. 2294/2020; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (LLC legal basis); Investment Law No. 72/2017 and GAFI implementing decrees requiring the identification, filing and updating of a beneficial-ownership register; AML/CFT rules issued by the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) and the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) for securities custody and private-banking relationships; Unified Tax Procedures Law No. 206/2020 requiring UB-owner identification on tax registration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry in the shareholder's country of domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization: home-country notarization, home-country Ministry of Foreign Affairs certification, then legalization by the Egyptian Consulate/Embassy (Egypt is not a Contracting State to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry / corporate secretary in the country of domicile

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Irrevocable Power of Attorney for the incorporation agent and the family-office legal counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign shareholder and/or UBO before a notary public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy certified by the home-country competent authority and legalized by the Egyptian Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Ultimate Beneficial Ownership declaration (GAFI/FRA compliant form)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Each UBO (natural person) before a notary public

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and six-month account activity summary of the foreign shareholder/UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Private bank or custodian maintaining the family's accounts

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified true copy from the home registry, legalized by the Egyptian Consulate

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence and dynamic re-screening of all UBOs, directors, authorized signatories and first-degree family members against: (i) UN consolidated sanctions lists (UNSCR 1267/1989/1988 and successors); (ii) Egypt's domestic list of terrorists and terrorist entities administered by the National Committee for Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing; (iii) the US OFAC SDN list; and (iv) EU and UK consolidated sanctions lists. The ISIC 6430 single-family-office is profiled as Medium_Risk_Enhanced, requiring source-of-wealth documentation, senior-management approval of the banking/custody relationship, beneficial-ownership filing with GAFI, and periodic re-screening at least annually and upon any ownership change.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop electronic portal (General Authority for Investment and Free Zones) - www.investinegypt.gov.eg / gafi.gov.eg, with final inscription at the Commercial Registry offices of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The LLC name must be stated in Arabic script and may include a transliterated foreign-language element; a parallel Latin-script commercial name may be filed. The name must correspond to at least one corporate object (private family-asset investment / single-family-office holding), must end with the 'LLC' legal-form indicator, must not be identical or confusingly similar to existing registered names or trademarks, and must exclude regulated financial, geographic or governmental terms absent prior ministerial clearance.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A reserved name may be renewed for successive 30-day periods by paying the renewal fee before expiry; a lapsed name cannot be re-reserved for 30 days. Upon rejection, the applicant may file, within 15 days of the electronic refusal notice, a written appeal to the GAFI Name Clearance Committee, attaching the refusal notice, a corrected Arabic transliteration, a trademark-similarity search and a legal memorandum distinguishing the proposed name from the conflicting entry. A second refusal is appealable administratively to the GAFI Complaint Unit and thereafter to the Economic Administrative Court within 60 days of the final administrative decision. Budget for appeal legal fees is itemized below.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Pure virtual offices and mail-forwarding addresses are not permissible as a statutory registered office. The LLC must have a physical Egyptian address in the memorandum of association where statutory registers, minutes, accounting records and corporate documents are kept. A serviced office or licensed business centre located in Egypt with dedicated workspace is acceptable; a virtual mailbox without physical presence fails the commercial-substance and Egyptian Tax Authority inspection tests.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-high: approximately 35% probability of unannounced physical inspection by GAFI, the Commercial Registry or the Egyptian Tax Authority within the first 24 months, rising to ~50% where the UBO register includes foreign PEPs or high-net-worth-family complex structures; inspections routinely verify effective management presence, record-keeping and substance of the single-family-office activity.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under Investment Law No. 72/2017 fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for LLC incorporations with investment-holding purposes

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of memorandum of association and domestic powers of attorney before an Egyptian notary public

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular legalization tariff of approx. $150 per document; Egypt is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law No. 194 of 2020 Promulgating the Companies Law, as amended by Law No. 4 of 2023, Articles 664-704 (Limited Liability Companies); Executive Regulations issued by Decree No. 96 of 2021; and Law No. 34 of 1976 on the Commercial Registry, as amended. Single-family office holding activity requires no special-purpose financial license under the Capital Market Law No. 95 of 1992, provided it administers only private family assets.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) – One-Stop Investor Services Center (Shatt El-Maaref), Commercial Registry Department of the Ministry of Trade and Industry, and the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Electronic Incorporation File (Mulaff El-Taasis) comprising the duly executed Memorandum of Association (MOA) and Articles of Association (AOA) of the LLC, submitted through the GAFI e-Services portal or in person at the Investor Services Center
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is imposed on LLCs under Law No. 194 of 2020; declared nominal capital of as low as EGP 1,000 is permitted. The declared capital must be fully subscribed and fully paid at formation, evidenced by a certificate of bank deposit in a corporate account with a licensed Egyptian bank; no escrow or notarized transfer account is required for cash contributions. In-kind contributions require a certified appraiser's report attached to the MOA.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that (1) the incorporation of the Company as an Egyptian limited liability company under Law No. 194 of 2020 is ratified and the declared share capital of EGP 1,000 is fully subscribed by the founding members; (2) the registered office at 17 Corniche El-Nil, Cairo, Egypt is adopted for statutory notices and service of process; (3) [Manager A] and [Manager B] are appointed as managers and joint authorized signatories; (4) the managers are authorized to open corporate bank accounts, complete commercial registration, tax, social insurance, and all administrative filings; and (5) the Company shall confine its operations wholly to the private single-family office holding and asset administration mandate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Identity Collision Check
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI e-Services Portal (eservices.gafi.gov.eg) – Name Reservation Module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the GAFI portal, select 'Company Establishment', enter the chosen corporate name in Arabic and English, and submit the identity-check request against the Commercial Registry database and GAFI's reserved-name index. The name must not duplicate an existing registered name, contain prohibited religious or military references, or misrepresent the single-family-office scope. Upon approval, pay the reservation fee online and obtain the official name reservation receipt valid for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Three proposed corporate names in Arabic and English
Copy of each founding member's valid national ID or passport
Power of attorney for the local incorporation agent, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or public-policy grounds, file a formal reconsideration request through the GAFI portal; simultaneously submit amended name alternatives to avoid re-runs, and await a binding written determination within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Authentication of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Justice – Notarization Department (Advisory/Notary Offices), or GAFI-approved Digital Signing Service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the MOA and AOA in Arabic containing entity type, corporate name, registered office, object, capital, shareholders, managers, and dispute-resolution clauses. All founding members must appear before the notary public, or execute via the secure electronic signature service, to authenticate the MOA and AOA. Obtain the authenticated instrument and the notary's stamp, which is condition precedent for GAFI's incorporation docket.
required_dossiers: Draft MOA and AOA in Arabic
Notarized copies of shareholder ID/passport and proof of address
GAFI name reservation receipt
Declaration of capital and method of payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary certifies defective signature or incomplete capital clauses, correct the instrument and re-execute; no penalty is triggered if the correction is filed within the name-reservation validity period.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop Incorporation Filing and Legal Entity Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Center (One-Stop Shop), Cairo Headquarters or regional branches
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete electronic incorporation file through the GAFI portal or in person at the One-Stop Shop. Include the authenticated MOA/AOA, name reservation, capital-deposit certificate from a licensed Egyptian bank, and fee payment. GAFI reviews legal compliance, completes registration in the Commercial Registry, issues the incorporation certificate, registers the Company's place of business, and coordinates the VAT and tax registration subsystems. Collect the final Tax Card (Bitaqa Dharibia) after payment of the prescribed stamp fees.
required_dossiers: Authenticated MOA and AOA
Bank certificate evidencing deposit of declared capital
GAFI name reservation receipt
Fees and stamp duty payment receipts
Valid IDs/passports of all founding members
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If GAFI queries an incomplete or conflicting document, the applicant receives a written defect memo; cure within 15 days by uploading amended documents; if unresolved, lodge a complaint with the GAFI Customer Care Committee, with binding response within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Enrollment, Tax Card and Statutory Registration Integration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry (Ministry of Trade and Industry) through GAFI One-Stop Shop; Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Finalize the Commercial Registry record with the validated Board Resolution appointing managers; enroll with the ETA for corporate income tax, VAT (if applicable), and import/export code only if the SFO conducts trade; the company obtains its federal tax identification number and integrated registration file. Register the company's constitution with the notary office and publish the legal notice in the form prescribed by the Executive Regulations.
required_dossiers: Incorporation certificate issued by GAFI
Tax card application form (Form No. 1)
Registered managers' IDs and proof of authority
Lease contract or title deed of registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the ETA or Commercial Registry rejects due to address or manager inconsistencies, present corrected MOA and lease contract, and use the expedited escalation desk at the One-Stop Shop for same-day resolution options.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance Registration, Corporate Seal, and Corporate Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI); GAFI Licensing Unit for seal-engraving permit; Central Bank of Egypt-licensed commercial bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Proceed to NOSI to register the company and its covered employees, obtain the social insurance file number, and complete the company seal engraving request with the GAFI Licensing Unit. Then open a corporate transactional account at a licensed Egyptian bank, presenting the company's incorporation certificate, commercial registration, tax card, NOSI registration, and a board resolution designating authorized signing officers. Given the SFO's Medium-Risk Enhanced AML tier, the bank will require ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) disclosure, source-of-wealth documentation, and expected-transaction volumes before activation.
required_dossiers: Incorporation certificate and Commercial Registry extract
Tax card and NOSI registration certificate
Managers' and UBO's passport copies and proof of residence
Board Resolution on authorized signatories
AML/KYC forms: source of wealth, family asset declaration, expected payment rails (private banking wire, securities custody)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If NOSI or the bank defers approval, supplement KYC with notarized family-trust deeds, auditor-confirmed statements, and a chart of the SFO's investment structure; escalate unresolved cases to the bank's AML Compliance Officer or, ultimately, to the Central Bank's Customer Protection Department for guidance.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable – no industrial board exercises jurisdiction over an office-based single-family office; administrative clearances only are issued through GAFI's Licensing Unit and the local municipal authority (Mahalla/Sheyakha office)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – SFO is a non-industrial, non-commercial holding and family-asset administration vehicle; no statutory operating permit is required, but the company must hold a valid Tax Card, Commercial Registry extract, and proof of the registered office's building-compliance certificate

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA) – Environmental Impact Assessment Department
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – the registered office is a leased or owned commercial office with no manufacturing, storage of hazardous materials, or industrial discharge; no EIA scoping or registration letter is required
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Office operations must comply with the general provisions of Law No. 4 of 1994 (as amended by Law No. 9 of 2009 and Law No. 202 of 2020): wastewater may only discharge into the municipal sewer system within the Egyptian Holding Company for Water and Wastewater's quality standards; no VOC-emitting equipment or fuel-burning installations permitted; office solid waste must be segregated and collected through the licensed municipal or contracted private carrier, with an internal waste-handling log for audit trail purposes

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense certification is required for the office premises: obtain a fire-safety inspection and fire-extinguishing system certificate from the Civil Defense Authority, ensure the building's structural load capacity and electrical installation are certified by the competent municipality, and maintain a valid occupancy/operating license issued by the local Sheyakha/Mahalla; workplaces with 10 or fewer employees require only a self-certified health and safety clearance, but the SFO must keep an adequate first-aid kit, emergency exit plan, and an annual fire-alarm test record.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance — National Tax Portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg; E-Invoicing Portal: https://einvoicing.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity must apply to the ETA for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) using the unified tax registration form. Required documents include legalized certificate of incorporation and memorandum, commercial register extract, board resolution appointing a local tax representative, notarized power of attorney, proof of Egyptian registered office address, and passport copies of officers. The application is submitted online through the ETA portal or via an accredited tax consultant; the ETA issues a single 10-digit TIN that also functions as the VAT identification number when VAT registration is compulsory. The process typically takes 5–10 business days. Separately, the entity must complete e-invoicing registration by obtaining a digital signing certificate and API credentials from the ETA’s clearance system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or pass-through election is available under Egyptian law; an LLC is mandatorily taxed as an entity separate from its shareholders. Relevant statutory elections include: (i) consolidated corporate tax filing for groups with at least 95% ownership of subsidiaries under Article 61 of Income Tax Law No. 91/2005; (ii) free-zone or special economic zone tax exemption election for qualifying investment activities; and (iii) certain ETA-approved simplified VAT accounting/cash-basis arrangements for small taxpayers. No hybrid mismatch election exists under domestic law; OECD hybrid mismatch rules may indirectly apply through tax treaties or MLI provisions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 in annual taxable turnover for mandatory VAT registration; non-resident suppliers making taxable supplies in Egypt may be required to register from the first supply even if below this threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: E-invoicing is mandatory for all VAT-registered persons under the ETA’s phased roll-out. Invoices and credit notes must be generated in XML/JSON format, digitally signed, and submitted in near-real-time to the ETA’s Invoice Clearance Center via REST API. Only cleared documents receive a transaction validation code, and each final invoice must display a QR code containing the TIN, invoice values, VAT amount, and clearance timestamp. Uncleared invoices are legally invalid, may be excluded from input VAT deduction, and may trigger penalties ranging from EGP 20,000 to EGP 100,000.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rated export treatment is available where goods are physically transferred outside Egypt under a valid customs declaration, title passes to a non-resident buyer, and the sale consideration is received in freely convertible foreign currency and repatriated to an Egyptian bank account within 180 days. For services, zero-rating applies where the service is supplied to a non-resident, is wholly consumed or used outside Egypt, and the consideration is denominated and received in foreign currency and remitted to Egypt within 180 days. The taxpayer must maintain full documentary evidence acceptable to the ETA demonstrating the export nature, the foreign recipient, and the foreign-currency settlement.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (certified by the Egyptian Customs Authority)
Bill of Lading (or Airway Bill / equivalent transport document evidencing physical export)
Inward Remittance Certificate / bank confirmation of foreign currency receipt
Commercial invoice and export contract (supporting the transaction’s commercial substance)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The ETA may conduct pre-refund and post-refund audits, with a five-year statutory limitation period. If a zero-rated claim is fraudulent or unsupported, the ETA will claw back the VAT amount understated, impose late-payment interest and administrative penalties (up to EGP 100,000 per violation), and may refer the matter for criminal prosecution. Tax evasion penalties can reach 100% of the tax evaded, in addition to imprisonment under Articles 72–76 of VAT Law No. 67 of 2016.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) - Foreign Exchange and International Dealings Directorate, Banking Supervision and AML Unit, operating under the Central Banking and Monetary System Law No. 194 of 2020, the Foreign Exchange Decree-Law No. 97 of 1976, and the AML/CFT Law No. 80 of 2002 as amended.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a flexible exchange-rate regime (IMF-supported unification effective March 2024). The Egyptian pound is fully convertible for current-account transactions through an authorised dealer bank without prior CBE approval, subject to documentary due diligence (invoices, tax clearances, audited financial statements, underlying contracts). Capital-account movements - equity injections, profit remittances, foreign-loan repayments - are transferable in practice but require the corporate resolution, tax clearance certificate issued by the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), and CBE transaction reporting; no separate CBE licence is required for a Single-Family-Office holding entity (ISIC 6430/NAICS 525920). The entity is not a regulated capital-market company, so Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) approval is not required, but banks will conduct enhanced source-of-funds verification given the Medium-Risk-Enhanced tier.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory conversion ratio applies to export proceeds after the 2016 foreign-exchange float; however, exporters must repatriate the full invoice value to an authorised Egyptian bank account within 90 days from the bill-of-lading date for goods (90 days from completion for services). Goods exports must be pre-registered on the ACI/Nafeza platform to obtain the customs ACID number, and proceeds may be retained in foreign-currency accounts or converted at the interbank rate. This SFO has no exporting activity, so the obligation is limited to maintaining zero-activity declarations and keeping foreign-currency accounts compliant with CBE periodic reporting.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) Egypt S.A.E.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary clearing rail; ancillary use only. Egypt requires CBE licensing for e-money issuance and electronic-payment aggregation; offshore digital EMIs without a CBE licence, local branch, or bank-agent agreement cannot hold Egyptian client funds, access the Instant Payment Network (IPN), or clear EGP obligations. Such EMIs may be engaged solely for FX-rate aggregation, reporting visualisation, and data consolidation, never as the legal repayment or collection channel for onshore SFO treasury flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-practice mandatory. Each authorised Egyptian bank requires at least one original signatory (the LLC manager or delegated director) to attend a face-to-face KYC/AML interview at the branch before account activation; the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO), where non-resident, may complete the interview by video only with a formal risk-committee exception, which is rarely granted for Medium-Risk-Enhanced structures. All constitutional documents (memorandum and articles of association, capital-increase resolutions, GAFI commercial-registry extract, unified tax registration card) must be notarised, legalised through the consular chain or apostille where applicable, and accompanied by certified Arabic translations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex multi-entity SFO ownership veil with non-resident beneficiaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Legalised certificate of incorporation and consolidated articles; GAFI commercial-registry extract; full shareholding ledger tracing UBOs at every tier (statutory AML threshold 25%, with banks applying a 10% or controlling-individual standard); organisational chart with passport copies; auditor's ownership-attestation letter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP or high-profile-family screening hit on UBO or directors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised PEP declaration under CBE AML Rule; signed source-of-wealth and source-of-funds statements; 12-month bank and portfolio statements; independent Egyptian-counsel opinion; economic-net-worth certificate from a licensed Egyptian CPA.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large capital-escrow injection without visible operating activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised capital-increase resolution and amended authorised-capital documents; callable-capital notices; inward-remittance purpose code matched to the CBE economic-statistics declaration; provenance statement on the remitting bank account; executed investment mandate or SFO settlement statement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Negative media or sanctions-list false hit
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions-screening report (OFAC, EU, UN, and local lists) generated by an accredited vendor; corporate remediation memorandum; Egyptian AML legal opinion; audited financial statements and ETA tax transcripts demonstrating a continuous compliant treasury history.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All injections must arrive via SWIFT MT103/MT202 through the nominated relationship bank, with the beneficiary account title matching the Egyptian LLC name exactly and the remitter matching the registered shareholder name. The banker's 'purpose of remittance' field must cite the capital call / equity-increase category used for CBE inward reporting. The file must be pre-delivered to the bank: notarised capital-increase resolution, updated GAFI/commercial-registry extract, shareholder identification, and provenance statement; funds are credited after KYC/AML dashboards clear, booked to the capital-escrow sub-ledger, and reported to CBE in the monthly external-position statement. Use one single entry bank to avoid duplicated CBE reporting; correspondent routing via New York or European clearers is standard for USD and EUR legs.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outgoing treasury payments use SWIFT MT103 executed through the relationship bank with strict beneficiary-name matching and purpose codes (management fees, advisory fees, securities settlement). Trade settlements and operational disbursements above the de-minimis threshold require underlying documentary support (contract, pro forma invoice, tax forms); commercial letters of credit (sight or usance, MT700/MT707) and documentary collections are the permitted rails for goods and commodities, with the ACI/Nafeza ACID number mandatory for import customs clearance. Profit and dividend remittances to non-resident shareholders require an ETA withholding-tax clearance certificate and the bank's profit-transfer declaration, subject to the applicable domestic dividend withholding tax (generally up to 10%, with treaty relief available). All outbound FX is executed at interbank rates with no surrender obligation.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/EGP forward contracts (tenor up to 12 months) against documented commercial or treasury exposure, executed through the CBE-licensed relationship bank under prudential limits.
Offshore USD/EGP non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for portfolio-level hedging where onshore limits are exhausted, booked only through a non-resident counterparty.
USD/EGP FX swaps (spot/deliverable) for liquidity-mismatch management between capital-escrow and operational sub-ledgers.
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/EGP) for offshore asset-liability matching executed via the securities custodian or prime broker.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return and tax declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after fiscal year-end; if the fiscal year is 1 January to 31 December, filing is due by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fine of EGP 500 plus monthly late-payment penalty of 2% of unpaid tax; continued non-payment may result in enforced collection and criminal exposure under Income Tax Law 91/2005

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory financial statements with independent auditor's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI); commercial registry corporate file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after fiscal year-end and before the annual members' general assembly approval meeting
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Managers are jointly liable for losses caused by default; GAFI can impose administrative monetary penalties and may order judicial strike-off for persistent non-filing

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership confirmation and shareholders register update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI real beneficial owner registry; Egyptian AML/CFT enforcement unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March for the prior calendar year, or within 30 days of any shareholding transfer or UBO change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to EGP 200,000 and/or imprisonment under AML Law 80/2002 as amended; banks and counterparties will treat the entity as non-compliant for KYC purposes

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commercial Registry Office, Ministry of Trade and Industry (MOTI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during the calendar month corresponding to the original commercial registration date, or within 30 days of any registered factual change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative suspension of the commercial registration record; the LLC may be unable to negotiate cheques, open accounts, or complete notarized transactions until the confirmation is cured

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory audit applies to all Egyptian limited liability companies; there is no size or revenue exemption. The members must appoint an independent auditor at each annual assembly, and the auditor's report must cover the annual financial statements submitted to the commercial registry file.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS), which are issued by ministerial decree and substantially converge with IFRS for non-listed private entities; stand-alone IFRS presentation is not mandatory for a private LLC.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain a real-beneficial-owner register and submit a required annual confirmation to GAFI identifying every individual with 10% or more shareholding, voting power, or control. Every share transfer must be registered in the statutory shareholders book and reported to GAFI within 30 days as part of the continuous UBO updating cycle.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% of worldwide taxable income for Egyptian tax-resident companies (Law 91 of 2005, Article 30; the same rate is preserved by Law 64 of 2025, the new Income Tax Law). No sub-national corporate income tax is superimposed; a 10% distributed-profits tax is integrated into the dividend withholding mechanism.
